mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings prospects, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales, each exceeding their 3-month moving average, indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that typically leads to reduced corporate profits and increased risk of monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0 for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI inflation rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals accelerating price pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has increased over the past month, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of robust consumer demand, as measured by housing starts and retail sales both above their 6-month moving averages, the S&P 500 tends to outperform due to elevated corporate revenue growth expectations, particularly when the economy is in an expansion phase.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 6-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous slowdown in employment growth (PAYEMS growth rate below 3-month moving average) and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE increasing by more than 0.3 percentage points in one month) signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate < 3mo_MA and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS growth rate is below 3-month moving average and UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
